purpose: General, jurisdiction-neutral solvency check: total_assets_musd / total_liabilities_musd, plus surplus_shortfall_musd = total_assets_musd - total_liabilities_musd, per asset-class and liability-class breakdown, rolled up. COVERED at or above 1.0, SHORTFALL below it. A zero-liabilities line resolves coverage_ratio null and status NO_LIABILITIES_OUTSTANDING -- never a division artifact. Aggregate totals only (no per-customer or per-wallet line item). No single normative anchor exists for exchange-level asset/liability coverage (unlike bank capital-adequacy ratios elsewhere in the suite) -- stated explicitly rather than inventing a crosswalk citation.
